import cache

def test_make_key_basic():
    assert cache.make_key("text", "profile", "criteria") == "text|profile|criteria"

def test_make_key_different_inputs():
    key1 = cache.make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")
    key2 = cache.make_key("text", "profile", "criteria2")
    assert key1 != key2

def test_make_key_different_text():
    key1 = cache.make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")
    key2 = cache.make_key("text2", "profile", "criteria")
    assert key1 != key2

def test_make_key_different_profile():
    key1 = cache.make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")
    key2 = cache.make_key("text", "profile2", "criteria")
    assert key1 != key2

def test_make_key_different_criteria():
    key1 = cache.make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")
    key2 = cache.make_key("text", "profile", "criteria2")
    assert key1 != key2

def test_make_key_none_values():
    key1 = cache.make_key("text", None, None)
    key2 = cache.make_key("text", None, None)
    assert key1 == key2
    assert key1 == "text|None|None"

def test_make_key_empty_strings():
    key1 = cache.make_key("", "", "")
    key2 = cache.make_key("", "", "")
    assert key1 == key2
    assert key1 == "||"
